caseName: Puyallup Tribe, Inc. v. Department of Game
caseNameFull: Puyallup Tribe, Inc. v. Department of Game of Washington

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Wash. [Certiorari granted, 429 U. S. 976.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
